facts.text: The hotel is an oceanfront retreat on Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach.
facts.excerpt: Located along Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach, this oceanfront retreat merges Art Deco character with modern design

facts.text: The design merges Art Deco character with modern design, infused with local texture and detail.
facts.excerpt: this oceanfront retreat merges Art Deco character with modern design, infused with local texture and detail.

facts.text: The complex was originally built in the 1940s as the 18-floor Lord Tarleton Hotel, Miami Beach's first skyscraper.
facts.excerpt: originally built in the 1940s as the 18-floor Lord Tarleton Hotel, Miami Beach's first skyscraper

facts.text: A historic 1929 single-family house on site has been preserved and restored as the clubhouse for a private members club on the property.
facts.excerpt: A 1929 historic, single-family house is located on-site and has been preserved and restored to function as the clubhouse for a private members club on property.

facts.text: The lobby is in hues of aqua, mint, turquoise and sage, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing Atlantic views.
facts.excerpt: The elevated lobby is awash in hues of aqua, mint, turquoise, and sage—echoing the views of the Atlantic framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and curvilinear couches.

facts.text: There is no check-in desk; each guest is seated and personally welcomed with a cocktail.
facts.excerpt: In signature Andaz fashion, there is no check-in desk; instead, each guest is seated and personally welcomed with a cocktail

facts.text: The hotel occupies a full city block and has plenty of sitting areas and lounges for quiet moments.
facts.excerpt: Occupying a full city block, the hotel is sprawling but feels intimate, with plenty of sitting areas and lounges for quiet moments.

facts.text: Many rooms and suites have private balconies with oceanfront or city skyline views.
facts.excerpt: many offer private balconies with sweeping oceanfront views or glittering city skylines

facts.text: Rooms have sea-inspired palettes, Byredo bath products and a Nespresso coffee maker.
facts.excerpt: each features luxurious linens, Byredo bath amenities, a Nespresso coffee maker, and a hotel-branded beach bag in each room

facts.text: The Two-Bedroom Ocean Terrace Suite with Soaking Tub has two king bedrooms, an oversized soaking tub and a wraparound terrace with panoramic ocean views.
facts.excerpt: This two-bedroom suite features two king bedrooms and two separate bathrooms, including a signature bath with an oversized soaking tub. A wraparound terrace opens to panoramic ocean views

facts.text: The Crown Suite overlooks the Intracoastal Waterway and Miami skyline and has a private terrace with an outdoor dining table.
facts.excerpt: The private terrace includes an outdoor dining table, ideal for morning coffee or in-room dining.

facts.text: The multi-level pool decks have two pools.
facts.excerpt: the expansive multi-level pool decks, which feature two pools and are perfect for luxuriating solo or enjoying with the family

facts.text: The terrace swimming pool has a hydraulic floor that rises to create a solid surface for special events, a first for Miami.
facts.excerpt: And—a first for Miami—the property’s terrace swimming pool features a hydraulic floor system that seamlessly elevates the pool floor to create a solid surface fitting for special events.

facts.text: The Ondara spa is on the fourth-floor terrace and offers advanced skincare and touchless therapies using Obagi products.
facts.excerpt: The smartly designed Ondara spa, perched on the fourth-floor terrace, features all of the cutting-edge beauty and wellness treatments that Miami is known for, including advanced skincare and touchless therapies using Obagi Skincare products.

facts.text: The spa relaxation lounge has loungers with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: The relaxation lounge where you await your treatment features ergonomic loungers with views of the ocean

facts.text: Daily wellness programs include signature classes, many complimentary for hotel guests, from yoga flow to high-intensity interval training.
facts.excerpt: Experience daily wellness programs featuring signature classes, many complimentary for Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa guests. From yoga flow to high-intensity interval training

facts.text: The hotel is home to three José Andrés restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Home to three celebrated José Andrés restaurants

facts.text: Aguasal by José Andrés is the signature restaurant, with coastal Mediterranean cooking inspired by Miami to Mallorca.
facts.excerpt: this signature restaurant offers a seaside celebration of bold coastal flavors, drawing inspiration from Miami to Mallorca

facts.text: The hotel has on-site electric bikes for rides along the paved beach path beside the ocean.
facts.excerpt: The paved beach path that flanks the ocean is great for morning walks or for bike rides using the hotel’s on-site electric bikes.

facts.text: South Beach is a 15-minute drive away; Soho House and the Fontainebleau are within walking distance.
facts.excerpt: South Beach is a 15-minute drive away, but there’s also the neighboring Soho House and the Fontainebleau hotels within walking distance

facts.text: Pets are welcome, with dog-friendly rooms stocked with a bowl, cookie and toy.
facts.excerpt: Our dog-friendly rooms are stocked with amenities that include a doggy bowl, doggy cookie, doggy toy and pet-in-room door hanger.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed in restaurants, on the pool deck or beach, in the Andaz Lounge or fitness center.
facts.excerpt: are not allowed in restaurants, the pool deck, beach, Andaz Lounge or fitness center

facts.text: Miami International Airport is 11 miles away.
facts.excerpt: Miami International Airport (MIA)11 miles

facts.text: Self-parking is on-street at Miami Beach city parking rates.
facts.excerpt: Available on-street parking at Miami Beach city parking rates.

facts.text: It is the first Andaz to open in Florida.
facts.excerpt: this is the first Andaz to open in Florida

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler calls it a refined, relaxed, upscale spot for a less-crowded Miami Beach vacation.
facts.excerpt: A refined, relaxed, and upscale spot to enjoy a less-crowded Miami Beach vacation.
